description: Get SMS messages for a specific phone number, identified by its number ID. Returns a list of individual messages — each with its timestamp, sender, recipient, and text — rather than grouped conversation threads.

limit.description: How many of the most recent messages to return.

number_id.description: The ID of the number whose messages you want, from list_numbers.

name: get_messages

outputSchema.description: Messages for a specific phone number.

data.description: Messages for the number, newest first.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: Get Messages
